settings.title: Protect Your Investment & Avoid Unexpected Breakdowns

settings.editor: Your heating and air conditioning system is one of the biggest investments in your home. Just like changing the oil in your car, regular preventive maintenance extends the life of your equipment, preserves your manufacturer warranty, and keeps your monthly utility bills as low as possible.

With a Mid Lakes HVAC Service Agreement, you never have to worry about remembering to schedule your seasonal tune-ups. Our NATE and EPA-certified technicians handle the care for you, keeping your home comfortable in every season across Walton, Gwinnett, DeKalb, and surrounding counties.

settings.editor: Included

settings.title: What’s Included in Your Mid Lakes Service Agreement

settings.editor: Our preventive service program is designed to give you total peace of mind and exclusive financial savings throughout the year:
Comprehensive seasonal maintenance, one Spring AC tune-up and one Fall Heating tune-up, to prepare your system for extreme Georgia weather.
Agreement holders enjoy 5% off all needed replacement parts, repairs, and labor.
Agreement members skip the line with priority scheduling on all service calls, including late-night and weekend emergencies.
Properly cleaned and calibrated systems run at peak efficiency, helping slash monthly power costs.
Regular tune-ups catch minor wear-and-tear before it turns into a major, expensive system breakdown.
Major HVAC manufacturers require documented proof of annual professional maintenance to keep valid warranty coverage on parts.
Inspections

settings.title: What Happens During Your Seasonal Tune-Ups?

settings.editor: Our certified technicians bring over 75 years of combined experience to every inspection.
Spring Air Conditioning Tune-Up Checklist

icon_list.text: Inspect and clean evaporator & condenser coils
Check refrigerant charge levels & system operating pressure
Inspect & flush condensate drain lines to prevent water damage
Test capacitors, relays, & electrical connections for safety
Calibrate thermostat & verify proper home airflow

settings.editor: Fall Heating System Tune-Up Checklist

icon_list.text: Inspect heat exchanger & burner assembly for safe operation
Inspect blower motor & check internal electrical components
Inspect gas line connections & vent piping
Replace or inspect standard air filters

settings.editor: FAQs

items.item_title: When does my service agreement kick in after I sign up?
Do I need to be home for the entire tune-up appointment?
Will I receive reminders when it’s time for my Spring or Fall tune-up?
What if a technician finds a problem during my inspection?

settings.editor: Your coverage begins immediately upon enrollment. We’ll work with you to schedule your first seasonal tune-up right away or queue it up for the upcoming Spring/Fall maintenance window based on your system’s current needs.

Yes, an adult over 18 needs to be present. Because our technicians perform complete indoor and outdoor checks, including thermostat calibration, indoor coil inspections, and electrical testing, we need access to both your outdoor unit and interior equipment.

Absolutely. You don’t have to keep track of the calendar. Our team will reach out via call, text, or email ahead of each season to schedule your appointment at a time that works best for your schedule.

If we spot worn components or potential issues during your tune-up, our technician will explain the findings clearly and present your options before doing any extra work. As an agreement holder, you’ll automatically receive your 5% discount on any needed replacement parts or repairs.
